subject: 9mmhandgun
leg: control: Valve's own against the brief
label: 9mmhandgun, in the place of the game's models/v_9mmhandgun.mdl, models/p_9mmhandgun.mdl, models/w_9mmhandgun.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/w_grenade.mdl, models/w_satchel.mdl, models/w_357.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked A, A, D, D where the asset was B, D, A, B: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: The outline reads as a semi-automatic pistol in every view: slide on top, grip off the rear, trigger guard under the slide, muzzle at the far end. Lying on its side, it matches the brief's pose, and no part sticks out or is missing (sides.png, top, below, front-left).

M2.reason: Measured length is 9.5 against the brief's 10, which is 2.8% off and within 15%. Width 1.9 and height 9.7 are the lying-on-side extents, with nothing out of scale (measurements).

M3.reason: The brief names only a pistol, and the parts every Valve gun in the line-up shows are the trigger and guard. The guard is clear in the left view under the slide and as a loop in the below view. A trigger blade sits inside that loop in the below view, though it is small at this scale. Slide serrations at the rear, the grip and the muzzle hole are all present (back, front-right, back-left). No front sight or magazine base is charged, as the brief does not name them.

M4.reason: The brief asks for black and grey polymer and steel. The slide reads as grey steel and the grip as dark charcoal polymer in the side, top and in-hand views, so each region has the brief's colour and material.

M5.reason: The slide's streaked texture smears along its length in the side and in-hand views, and the grip's grain reads as noise. Its serrations are soft rather than crisp. The brief names no markings, so the fault is sharpness only. This is paint, not shape, and it is charged to M5 alone.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 by the rule, and the line-up test agrees: the judges picked A, A, D, D where the asset was B, D, A, B, so they never picked it as the one not made by Valve and it passed for one of the game's.

M7.reason: The muzzle is at the end away from the grip, with the circular bore visible in the back and back-left views. The pistol lies on its side with its grip horizontal, as the brief asks, and stands on its origin the way a dropped pistol lies (top, below).

M8.reason: The SMAK check is reported clean (no errors). 88 triangles is under the median of 142 for Half-Life's own of its kind, so it is well within two times the median. Nothing is open or floating in the views: the bore at the muzzle is the only hole and is the barrel's own.

W1.reason: In the first-person view the pistol sits in the right hand where the game's own does, grip in the fist, barrel up and forward, the same way round. Through the 14-frame shoot attack it stays in the hand in every frame and does not part from it.
